title: 猴子捞月亮
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (教材 PDF index 12, printed p. 2) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第六课 runs pp. 58–66, 综合练习（二） starts p. 67. The 课文 is pp. 58–59 and p. 59 also carries 生字, 词语 and 句子 below it. 课堂练习 is pp. 60–63 (描一描写一写 and 读一读 60, 用一用 and 扩展与替换 61, 想一想/对话 62, 课堂游戏 63); the 阅读 text is pp. 64–65 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 66.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. The book prints 啊 with a toneless a, the reading it has at the end of a sentence (是啊) and the one the 课文 uses.

gloss.zh: 猴子，一种会爬树的动物

gloss.en: scoop something out of the water

gloss.zh: 太阳下山以后的时候；晚上
量词：聚在一起的很多个，像一群猴子
gloss.en: measure word for a crowd or a flock: a group of

gloss.zh: 放在句子末尾，加强语气，像"是啊"
gloss.en: a word at the end of a sentence that adds feeling, as in 是啊
join on, connect; next, then (接着)

句子.py: yuè liang bú shì hái zài tiān shang ma?

where.zh: 课本第61页 扩展与替换

句型.substitutions_note: The blue 替换 table under the ladder on p. 61: 月亮 不是 还在天上 吗？ with 月亮 and 还在天上 underlined and 不是 and 吗？ printed in red, then three rows that swap the two underlined parts. Shaped like L03's table, two parts to a row. The ladder's first rung is the pattern itself, as the card prints it.

读一读.page_break_note: all seven rows are on p. 60, under 描一描，写一写

用一用.rows_note: The book prints 跟着他做运动 on its own line under the two other 跟着 phrases; it is the same word's row, so it is kept with them, as L03 did with 生动. Only three of the seven 词语 get a row here: 跟着, 下面, 伸手.

阅读.text_note: same copyright hold as the 课文. The margin is on p. 65 only (p. 64 is title and picture) and prints ★ before each entry; 轻松, 力量, 团结 and 国家 carry two example phrases under them rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets, and 强盛's own gloss prints its bracket. p. 66 carries the reading's 想一想，说一说 (three questions) and 日积月累 (三思而后行。——《论语》), neither reproduced.
